structured.answer: I'd pick option א, the coin towers. The line "כל שקל שהפקדתם נהיה 3.70 ₪ בקרן ו-1.09 ₪ בחשבון ניירות ערך" plus a big pile (66,513 ₪) next to a small one (19,595 ₪) told me in seconds that the קרן is worth it because of the employer's money.
